name: Ronaldo Phantassi
role: Painter and occultist, fond of opium; once one of the Bookhounds
note: Gave one of his eyes to the emissary of Byatis, and now sees colours that shouldn’t exist. When the canvas burned he vanished, only to burst into the auction with the vagrants. Guzzy shot him.

name: Bob Carr
role: Veteran of the Boer War; once one of the Bookhounds
note: Found out that he is P. L. Westoby, and went into the painting to help destroy the followers of Nodens.

name: Johnstone Dives
role: Aristocrat and owner of emerald mines in South Africa
note: Hired the Bookhounds to find the Caedis Urbi Verae Claves. A follower of Byatis, he worked with Westoby against the followers of Nodens.

name: Paul Fletcher
role: Wealthy astronomer and follower of Nodens
note: Came from Cape Town to buy the Caedis Urbi Verae Claves, won the auction, and was shot for it.

name: Aston Drummel
note: Bacon’s agent for years. After threatening the shop, he made a truce with Charlie.

name: Magwich
role: Hired muscle, with a sooty bag
note: Went after the Bookhounds twice. Frankie shot him outside Westoby’s.

name: Francis Bacon
role: A young painter, not yet known
note: Stole the Caedis Urbi Verae Claves in France and auctioned it at the Ten Bells.

name: Aleister Crowley
note: The Bookhounds paid him a hundred pounds to explain the Caedis Urbi Verae Claves. He laughed when it burned.

name: Bastion Melwig
note: Brought On the Glory of Nodens to the shop, and was struck down by the painting.

name: Terry Flate
role: Irish barman at the Ten Bells
note: Knows Francis Bacon, and most of what goes on in the pub.

name: Robert D’Onstan
note: Called the hero of Nodens. In 1886 he wrote that the murders were a necromantic ritual; he died soon after.

name: Julian de Castries
role: Looter of the Caedis Urbi Verae Claves
note: Last showed the book off in Rome, in 1860.

name: Edward VIII
role: King of the United Kingdom and the Dominions, and Emperor of India
note: King since his father’s death in January 1936. He wants to marry Mrs. Wallis Simpson, an American who is divorcing her second husband, and the government and the Church are against it.

name: Mrs. Wallis Simpson
role: American, from Baltimore; divorced once and now divorcing again
note: The King’s constant companion. The American papers are full of her, while the British papers have kept quiet. The question is whether she could ever be Queen.

name: Stanley Baldwin
role: Prime Minister for the third time, since June 1935, and leader of the Conservatives
note: Cautious, and never without his pipe. He believes the King cannot marry Mrs. Simpson and stay on the throne, and the Dominions and the Church agree.

name: Winston Churchill
role: MP for Epping, out of office since 1929
note: Has been warning about Germany for years. In the Commons he is the King’s strongest supporter, pressing Baldwin to give the King more time.

name: Joachim von Ribbentrop
role: German Ambassador in London, from October 1936
